title: XXXII Diptych with Targets
description: Gallery photograph of two framed collages displayed side by side on a grey wall. Left panel features warplane silhouettes, bullseye targets, a chess piece, football, and numerals 'XXXII'; right panel emphasizes vertical ochre stripes, compact discs, and concentric-ring targets against a black-and-ivory ground.
composition: two framed works hung side by side
